d: Honey blonde hair with straight bangs and long, thick braided curls falling behind the shoulders, paired with soft grey eyes behind red-rimmed glasses on a youthful, mature face. The build is slender, dressed in a green beret with a gold emblem, a forest green capelet over a white ruffled bodice and a dark green corset. The outfit is accented by a gold bow at the neckline and a small leather-bound book held in one hand.
